questions.q: Two angles on a straight line measure $3x$ and $2x+30$. Find $x$.
questions.answer: Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$: $3x+2x+30=180\Rightarrow5x=150\Rightarrow x=30$.

questions.q: Find the angle vertically opposite a $65^{\circ}$ angle.
questions.answer: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the angle is $65^{\circ}$.

questions.q: Three angles around a point measure $110^{\circ}$, $95^{\circ}$, and $x$. Find $x$.
questions.answer: Angles around a point sum to $360^{\circ}$: $x=360-110-95=155^{\circ}$.

questions.q: Two angles are complementary (sum to $90^{\circ}$). One measures $37^{\circ}$. Find the other.
Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, creating an angle of $70^{\circ}$. Find its corresponding angle.
questions.answer: Corresponding angles are equal, so the angle is $70^{\circ}$.

questions.q: In the same setup, find the co-interior (allied) angle to a $70^{\circ}$ angle.
Find the alternate interior angle to a $55^{\circ}$ angle.
questions.answer: Alternate interior angles are equal, so the angle is $55^{\circ}$.

questions.q: Two parallel lines cut by a transversal create an angle of $4x$ and its co-interior angle of $2x+30$. Find $x$.

A triangle has three equal angles. Find each angle, and name this type of triangle.
questions.answer: $180\div3=60^{\circ}$ each — this is an equilateral (equiangular) triangle.

questions.answer: Treat it as a $10\text{ m}\times8\text{ m}$ rectangle with a $4\text{ m}\times3\text{ m}$ notch removed: $10\times8-4\times3=80-12=68$ m$^2$.

questions.q: A garden is L-shaped: a $15$ m by $6$ m rectangle with a $5$ m by $2$ m rectangle cut from one corner. Find its area.
A shape consists of a $12$ cm by $5$ cm rectangle with a right triangle of base $6$ cm and height $5$ cm attached to one of the short sides. Find the total area.
questions.answer: Rectangle: $12\times5=60$ cm$^2$. Triangle: $\dfrac{1}{2}\times6\times5=15$ cm$^2$. Total $=60+15=75$ cm$^2$.

questions.q: A rectangular box has dimensions $5$ cm $\times4$ cm $\times3$ cm. Find its volume.

Find the surface area of a rectangular box with dimensions $8$ cm $\times5$ cm $\times4$ cm.
A rectangular garden measuring 20 m by 15 m is surrounded by a path 1 m wide. Find the area of the path alone.
questions.answer: Outer dimensions: $22\text{ m}\times17\text{ m}=374$ m$^2$. Garden area: $20\times15=300$ m$^2$. Path area $=374-300=74$ m$^2$.

questions.q: New flooring costs 45 riyals per square meter. Find the total cost to floor a rectangular room measuring 6 m by 4 m.
A 17 m ladder leans against a vertical wall with its base 8 m from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
A jogger runs 4 laps of a circular track of radius 35 m, using $\pi=\dfrac{22}{7}$. Find the total distance covered.
questions.answer: One lap $=2\pi r=2\times\dfrac{22}{7}\times35=220$ m. Four laps $=4\times220=880$ m.
